items.title: AI Startup Manus Raises $500 Million After China Nixed Meta’s $2 Billion Acquisition
items.author: Jose Antonio Lanz
items.description: Manus built a self-driving AI assistant before the hype, sold itself to Meta, then watched Beijing unwind the deal. Its first fresh money since: more than $500 million.
items.content: Manus built a self-driving AI assistant before the hype, sold itself to Meta, then watched Beijing unwind the deal. Its first fresh money since: more than $500 million.

items.title: Google Wants Gemini to Be Your Next Coworker—Complete With Its Own Email Address
items.author: Jose Antonio Lanz
items.description: Google Cloud unveiled a single Gemini agent that takes goals instead of questions, works in the background for days, and can join a company as a staffer with its own inbox and calendar.

items.title: Ethereum Test Network Raises Block Limit to Over 3x Its Current Capacity
items.author: Jose Antonio Lanz
items.description: Ethereum's Sepolia test network activated Glamsterdam on October 6 with a block gas limit near 200 million, over three times mainnet's 60 million.
items.content: Ethereum's Sepolia test network activated Glamsterdam on October 6 with a block gas limit near 200 million, over three times mainnet's 60 million.

items.title: NFL Sides With States Against Kalshi in Supreme Court Prediction Market Fight
items.author: Decrypt Staff
items.description: The NFL urged the Supreme Court to resolve a circuit split over whether states can regulate sports contracts on prediction markets, arguing they're gambling, not federally regulated swaps.
items.content: The NFL urged the Supreme Court to resolve a circuit split over whether states can regulate sports contracts on prediction markets, arguing they're gambling, not federally regulated swaps.

items.title: Satoshi-Era Bitcoin Worth $8.3 Million Moves After 16 Years
items.author: Jose Antonio Lanz
items.description: A batch of 100.02 BTC mined in July 2010 moved Wednesday after 16 years. It's worth about $8.3 million, but nothing in the transaction shows who owns it.
items.content: A batch of 100.02 BTC mined in July 2010 moved Wednesday after 16 years. It's worth about $8.3 million, but nothing in the transaction shows who owns it.

items.title: Solana DeFi Firms Orca and Loopscale Merge Under New Formation Brand
items.author: Jose Antonio Lanz
items.description: Solana DEX Orca and lending platform Loopscale will operate as Formation, a New York company aiming to finance AI, energy, robotics and defense assets and eventually reach regulated U.S. markets.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs Suffer Worst Loss Since June as Uptober Turns Red
items.author: Jose Antonio Lanz
items.description: Investors yanked $484.9 million out of spot Bitcoin ETFs in a single day. Oil is near $100, bond yields are at their highest since 2002, and the Fed isn't done hiking.

items.title: Will AI Break Crypto Encryption? Ethereum’s Vitalik Buterin Weighs In on 'Bunker Mode' Shift
items.author: Ryan Gladwin
items.description: Ethereum co-founder Vitalik Buterin thinks the crypto industry needs to make sure encryption is both quantum and AI-resistant.

items.title: US Government Moves $1 Billion in Bitcoin Seized From Bitfinex Hacker
items.author: Decrypt Staff
items.description: A government wallet holding Bitcoin seized from the Bitfinex hacker sent 12,267 BTC to a new, unlabeled address, according to Arkham data.

items.title: From Uptober to Spooky Szn? Bitcoin Cuts September Gains in Half
items.author: Jose Antonio Lanz
items.description: Day traders are selling, leveraged longs are getting flushed and ETF money is heading for the door. The daily chart still holds the line, but its cushion is shrinking.
